title: Invoice emails not sending after the queue client release
author: Kit Amara
summary: For 1 h 10 min, Acme did not send invoice emails. Release v4.18.0 of invoice-service read the mail queue's credentials from a path production did not have. 4,860 invoices went out late. Rolling back to v4.17.3 mitigated it.
what_happened: At 13:40 UTC invoice-service v4.18.0 deployed. Errors began at 13:42. The send monitor paged on-call 37 min later, at 14:19. On-call rolled back at 14:49 and sends recovered by 14:52. The AI assistant's invoice chasing was paused at 14:44 so it would not chase invoices customers never received, and restarted once the backlog drained.

contributing_factors.factor: The new queue client read credentials from a secret path set in staging but not in production, and nothing checked the path before deploy.
The send monitor pages only when the success rate falls below 95% over a long window, so it paged 37 min after errors began.
The AI assistant chases unpaid invoices without checking that the invoice was delivered.

what_went_well: The team paused chasing before customers were chased for invoices they never got.
where_we_got_lucky: The outage began after most trades businesses had sent the day's invoices.

action_items.action: Add a deploy check that fails when a secret path the service reads is missing in the target environment.
action_items.done_when: A deploy to staging with a missing secret path fails the pipeline, shown in a test run.

action_items.action: Page on-call when invoice send errors appear, as well as on a low success rate.
action_items.done_when: A test error in invoice sending pages on-call, shown in a game-day drill.

action_items.action: Make the assistant skip any chase whose invoice has no delivery receipt.
action_items.done_when: A chase for an undelivered test invoice is skipped and logged.
